# Royal Wedding Hub

> Premier luxury wedding planning and curated heritage venue concierge in Lucknow, India.

Royal Wedding Hub curates bespoke destination weddings, royal Awadhi banquets, heritage palace lawns, fine-art cinema, and comprehensive luxury wedding orchestration across Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Venues
- [All Venues Catalog](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues): Curated portfolio of 32+ verified heritage wedding venues, palaces, and resort lawns in Lucknow.
- [Santorini Resort Lucknow](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/santorini-resort-lucknow): Luxury resort wedding setting with 42 rooms and capacity for up to 1000 guests.
- [Charans Club and Resort](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/charans-club-and-resort): Expansive wedding resort with 50 rooms and capacity for up to 2500 guests.
- [Magnolia Garden Marriage Lawn](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/magnolia-garden-marriage-lawn): Heritage banquet lawn for royal wedding gatherings up to 1800 guests.
- [Prayag Marriage Lawn](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/prayag-marriage-lawn): Classic marriage lawn hosting celebrations from 250 to 1200 guests.
- [Hotel Milenia Regency](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/hotel-milenia-regency): Luxury hotel wedding banquets accommodating 150 to 600 guests.
- [Yash Resort](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/yash-resort): Scenic resort venue with 50 rooms and lawn capacity for 2000 guests.
- [Anandi Water Park Resort](https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues/anandi-water-park-resort): Expansive lawn and resort venue for large celebrations up to 3000 guests.
